summary.text: Stewart is the Libertarian nominee for this open seat, a businessman and former law enforcement officer who has repeatedly run for statewide and federal office in Iowa as a Libertarian, including for U.S. Senate (2020) and governor (2022).

paragraphs.text: Stewart was born in Postville, Iowa, and raised in Maquoketa, according to his 2020 Candidate Connection survey; he lives in Cedar Rapids.

He graduated from Phillips Academy in 1969 and earned an associate degree in agricultural mechanics from Kirkwood Community College, a bachelor's degree from Coe College (1991), and a master's degree from the University of Chicago (1993).
By his own account, he spent two years traveling overland through Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, then worked as a police officer in Maquoketa.
Stewart says he started the natural foods business Frontier Natural Products Co-Operative in 1976 and retired in 1999; Ballotpedia lists him as its CEO.

After retiring he says he traveled, including hiking the Appalachian Trail, and that he maintains an apartment in Guatemala where he works with an orphanage and school; Ballotpedia lists affiliations with EDELAC and Quetzaltrekkers in Xela, Guatemala.
He ran as the Libertarian candidate for Iowa Secretary of Agriculture in 2018, for U.S. Senate in 2020, and for governor in 2022, and lost each general election.
